description: Human-readable documentation of the job-search instance model: dated pull files, per-job analysis sidecars, the approved-job queue, and the companies catalog. Source of truth is .ai/guardrails/locked-job-search-data-model.json.

identity_rules.sidecar_filename: Replace : with -; suffix -analysis.json. Example greenhouse:lts:4285142009 → greenhouse-lts-4285142009-analysis.json. JSON stores unsanitized job_id.
identity_rules.notes: board_token is the platform site slug (e.g. Greenhouse board token). source_job_id is [0-9]+. platform has no hyphen.

status_enum.new: Presence on jobs.json: first seen on this pull date. Pull writes this. Analysis and orchestrator never write jobs.json.status.
status_enum.active: Presence on jobs.json: still listed; id seen on the nearest prior pull. Pull writes this. Lookback does not copy qualification or queue terminals onto a new day's file (G5).
status_enum.closed: Greenhouse/TalentBrew: presence on a prior dated jobs.json when the id is absent from today's live board snapshot; CI stamps this (ADR-022 close-wins). SerpAPI: human last-seen JSON edit only (ADR-046); pull absence is not closed. Today's file stays live listings only. Closed jobs do not appear on the dashboard live join. Execution widgets may still list ledger rows for rolled-off or closed ids and resolve Title from historical dated src or slug fallback (ADR-047, ADR-048).

work_location_type_enum.unknown: No arrangement token found in allowlisted metadata or location/office names.

analysis_decision_enum.approved: Locked evidence shows competitive fit and no hard disqualifier. Orchestrator upserts approved-jobs.json.
analysis_decision_enum.rejected: Hard disqualifier or unmet mandatory requirement. No queue row.

requirement_importance_enum.mandatory: Lexical must/required/minimum or an explicit numeric minimum (e.g. 10+ years).
requirement_importance_enum.preferred: Unlabeled or non-must qualification. Gaps are documented and non-fatal.

requirement_result_enum.partial: Partially met; a must-have may pass only with explicit compensating locked evidence.
requirement_result_enum.not_evidenced: No matching locked field, empty/null field, or expired dated credential treated as not currently held.
requirement_result_enum.contradicted: Locked evidence conflicts with the requirement. Mandatory contradicted forces rejection.

queue_status_enum.approved: Orchestrator upserted after validated sidecar approved. Waiting for resume-tailor claim.
queue_status_enum.in_progress: Orchestrator claimed the row before launching resume-tailor.
queue_status_enum.failed: Structured failure; explicit retry back to in_progress. No automatic retry.
queue_status_enum.completed: Resume-tailor created its PR and returned. Does not mean the PR merged. Kept permanently in the jobs array.
queue_status_enum.deployed: Resume PR merged and Google Drive upload succeeded. CD stamps this after sync_gdrive.py. artifacts_url is the Drive {company}/{role} folder.

decision_impact_enum.none: External research is contextual only. Validators forbid using it as qualification evidence.

computed_overall_pipeline_status.notes: Not stored on jobs.json. Dashboard G9 computes this join from the latest dated src file only.
order: else sidecar is_current decision approved → approved, rejected → rejected

dashboard_widgets.notes: P2-D1 read-only POC. Live G9 table lists new|active rows from {platform}/src/{latest-date}/jobs.json only. PR ready / in progress / failed widgets are ledger-scoped and must show a non-empty Title even when the id is absent from that latest file (ADR-047, ADR-048).
title_resolution_order: live join row title (latest src, new|active only)
any remaining dated {platform}/src/*/jobs.json title for that id (latest non-empty wins)
position segment of sandbox_path, else feature_branch after feature/, kebab-to-display (not listing identity)

arrangement_gate.remote: Bypasses geography entirely; include_remote toggle applies.
arrangement_gate.hybrid: include_hybrid toggle, then locations.include geography match.
arrangement_gate.onsite: include_onsite toggle, then locations.include geography match.
arrangement_gate.unknown: Always passes the arrangement gate. include_* toggles apply only to known values (remote/hybrid/onsite). Filtered on geography only.
arrangement_gate.notes: locations.include is purely geographic (no Remote/Hybrid/On-Site tokens).

fields.pulled_at: UTC ISO datetime with Z suffix when the pull finished.
fields.jobs: Array of normalized job objects. Today's file is live listings only (new|active).

field_notes.id: Globally unique listing id {platform}:{board_token}:{source_job_id}. SerpApi: platform=serpapi, board_token=kebab_case(via) or unknown, source_job_id=decimal sha256(opaque job_id)[:8]. TalentBrew: platform=talentbrew, board_token=catalog company id (capital-one), source_job_id=listing seq from list a[data-job-id] (digits only, never the Workday R… requisition).
field_notes.status: Presence only on this file: pull writes new|active. Greenhouse/TalentBrew CI stamps closed on the nearest prior dated file when the id is absent from today's board snapshot (ADR-022). SerpAPI never auto-closes (ADR-046); a human may set closed on the last-seen dated row. G10: schema enum is new|active|closed only. Qualification approved|rejected lives on sidecar decision; queue approved|in_progress|failed|completed|deployed is a separate enum.
field_notes.title: Position / job title.
field_notes.company: Employer display name from companies.json name or source metadata.
field_notes.pulled_at: YYYY-MM-DD pull date on the job record.
field_notes.status_updated_at: UTC ISO datetime with Z suffix. Stamp now only when presence status changes. new→active stamps now; active→active copies the nearest-prior row timestamp; new id stamps now; Greenhouse/TalentBrew close-missing stamps now on newly closed prior rows; SerpAPI human close stamps now on the last-seen row.
field_notes.work_location_type: Required arrangement enum (remote|hybrid|onsite|unknown). Replaces the former remote boolean.
field_notes.description_text: Plain text for keyword matching and analysis. Never scanned for arrangement tokens.
field_notes.raw: Optional truncated ATS payload for audit.
field_notes.posted_at: Required YYYY-MM-DD or null (ADR-039). Parsed at ingest from source post dates. Never invent from updated_at or pulled_at. Merge keeps prior date when new parse is null.
field_notes.workday_requisition_id: Optional. TalentBrew always writes the key (R[0-9]+ or null) from detail span.job-id.job-info / meta job-ats-req-id / JSON-LD identifier. Greenhouse and SerpApi omit the key. Not listing identity and not the merge/close-missing key (ADR-043).

companies_file.notes: Cross-platform company catalog (ADR-038). Replaces greenhouse/boards.json. Greenhouse pull reads enabled ats.platform=greenhouse rows. TalentBrew pull reads enabled company-slot rows (company.enabled, career origin). industries[] is catalog metadata; fetch scripts do not filter on it. Phase 2 discovery is parked.

company_row.name: Employer display name.
company_row.industries: Array of unique non-empty strings. Empty array is untagged. Horizontal scale is more tags; vertical scale is more companies sharing a tag. No locked vocabulary in Phase 1.
company_row.ats: Ingest source slot (ATS). Same shape as company slot.
company_row.company: Ingest source slot (company site). platform and board_token must equal parent id. TalentBrew ingest reads enabled company slots (ADR-043). Greenhouse ingest still ignores this slot.

source_slot.enabled: Per-source toggle. Both slots may be true.
source_slot.platform: On ats: greenhouse|lever|ashby|unknown, or empty when SerpApi (or other ingest) has not seen an ATS URL. On company: parent id.
source_slot.board_token: ATS board slug, or parent id on the company slot. Empty when ats is unpopulated.
source_slot.career_url: Board or careers URL. Empty string allowed. SerpApi first-fills blank fields only and never overwrites populated values. ATS listing URL is stored only when it contains both ats.platform and ats.board_token. Company-slot URL is the careers origin only (scheme://host, no path or query), stored only when that host contains a distinctive part of the employer name (e.g. https://jobs.firstcitizens.com for First Citizens Bank). Aggregator apply links are left empty.
source_slot.source: Empty string is default (unwritten). serpapi is stamped when SerpApi first-fills that slot and is then locked. manual is reserved for user-entered companies. Scripts never overwrite a non-empty source; a user may edit companies.json by hand. url_detect and url_index are parked (not in the live enum).
source_slot.detected_at: YYYY-MM-DD when this slot was first written, or null if unpopulated. Not overwritten on later upserts.

fields.platform: Same platform key as the pull envelope.
fields.job_id: Unsanitized JOB.id. File PK. Must match every analyses[].job_id.
fields.analysis_id: FK to the unique analyses[] row with is_current true. Stub 0; first fill retargets to 1.
fields.updated_at: UTC ISO datetime with Z when the envelope last changed.

analyses.description: Array of ANALYSIS revision objects. Exactly one is_current.

item_fields.analysis_id: Unique inside the file. Integer. Stub 0; first fill mutates that row to 1. 0 is not retained as history. Validators must not treat 0 as missing.
item_fields.pull_date: YYYY-MM-DD. Stub/first-fill: UTC create-day of the pull that wrote the file. Later from-scratch rows (G6): UTC calendar date of that analysis run.
item_fields.revision: Integer. Stub 0 only. First fill mutates to 1. Edits increment on the current row. From-scratch appends start at 1. revision 0 is never written again after first fill.
item_fields.is_current: Boolean. Exactly one true per file. Envelope analysis_id always equals that row.
item_fields.run_id: Minted by generate-analysis-queue.py. Copied onto this row at first-fill or from-scratch. null on pull stubs. Same value for every job filled from that queue file. Not P2-A1 telemetry (telemetry is the closed keys below).
item_fields.analyzed_at: UTC ISO datetime with Z when this revision was filled. null on stub.
item_fields.justification: Concise overall rationale. null on stub.

requirements.jd_excerpt: Verbatim excerpt from the job description.
requirements.evidence: Prose citation of the locked fact used. No structured pointer into locked-job-data-model.json.

skills.requirements: Same REQUIREMENT object shape as experience.requirements.

constraints.requirements: Same REQUIREMENT object shape as experience.requirements.

external_context.sources: Always []. Qualification never uses live research. Company/role research for core_themes is recorded on core_themes, not here (ADR-053).

core_themes.notes: Optional on pull stubs and historical fills. Required on approved fills going forward (ADR-053). Shared by resume-tailor and cover-letter fill. job_skill_1..3 must exist in locked-skills.json. strength_1..3 and opening_hook are analysis-synthesized strings.
core_themes.job_skill_1: Primary locked hard skill matching a top JD requirement.
core_themes.job_skill_2: Secondary locked hard skill matching a core JD requirement.
core_themes.job_skill_3: Tertiary locked hard skill matching a JD requirement.
core_themes.opening_hook: One-sentence value proposition for the target company and role.

item_fields.started_at: P2-A1. UTC ISO datetime with Z when this analysis turn started. null-ok (stubs, batch/nested).
item_fields.ended_at: P2-A1. UTC ISO datetime with Z when this analysis turn ended. null-ok.
item_fields.tokens_in: P2-A1. Integer >= 0 or null. Do not invent on batch/nested invokes.
item_fields.context_metric_status: P2-A1. not_programmatically_available | observed. observed only when at least one usage field is non-null.

field_notes.analysis_id: Unique inside the file. Integer. Stub 0; first fill mutates that row to 1. 0 is not retained as history. Validators must not treat 0 as missing.
field_notes.pull_date: YYYY-MM-DD. Stub/first-fill: UTC create-day of the pull that wrote the file. Later from-scratch rows (G6): UTC calendar date of that analysis run.
field_notes.revision: Integer. Stub 0 only. First fill mutates to 1. Edits increment on the current row. From-scratch appends start at 1. revision 0 is never written again after first fill.
field_notes.is_current: Boolean. Exactly one true per file. Envelope analysis_id always equals that row.
field_notes.run_id: Minted by generate-analysis-queue.py. Copied onto this row at first-fill or from-scratch. null on pull stubs. Not P2-A1 telemetry.
field_notes.analyzed_at: UTC ISO datetime with Z when this revision was filled. null on stub.
field_notes.justification: Concise overall rationale. null on stub.
field_notes.core_themes: Optional object. Omitted on stubs, historical fills, and rejected jobs. Approved fills going forward write all seven strings (ADR-053). Not a qualification input.
field_notes.started_at: P2-A1 telemetry. UTC ISO datetime with Z or null.
field_notes.ended_at: P2-A1 telemetry. UTC ISO datetime with Z or null.
field_notes.tokens_in: P2-A1 telemetry. Integer >= 0 or null. Batch/nested writes null.
field_notes.context_metric_status: P2-A1 telemetry. not_programmatically_available | observed. Required; not null.

field_notes.jd_excerpt: Verbatim excerpt from the job description.
field_notes.evidence: Prose citation of the locked fact used. No structured pointer into locked-job-data-model.json.

field_notes.sources: Always [] by policy. Company/compensation WebSearch and WebFetch live in the resume-tailor engineering log, not on the analysis sidecar.

fields.jobs: Array of APPROVED_JOB rows. Pull creates the envelope only if missing (jobs: []). Never inserts rows. Orchestrator writes consume/claim/copy. CD deploy stamps deployed + artifacts_url after Drive success.

field_notes.id: JOB.id. Locate sidecar from platform folder plus encoded job_id under analyses/. Do not store file paths.
field_notes.analysis_id: FK to sidecar analyses[].analysis_id (G4). First fill: 1. Edit-bump does not change this FK. G6 from-scratch still-approved: orchestrator retargets to the new current id and stamps approved_at now. Batch consume also retargets post-handoff approved decisions.
field_notes.approved_at: UTC ISO datetime with Z of the orchestrator upsert. Refresh on every approved consume (first-fill and update-fill).
field_notes.status: queue_status_enum: approved|in_progress|failed|completed|deployed. Not jobs.json.status. Consume upserts approved (including post-handoff retarget). Orch claims in_progress. Tailor copy writes completed or failed. CD stamps deployed after Drive success.
field_notes.status_updated_at: Required UTC ISO datetime with Z when queue status last changed. First-fill stamps consume now.
field_notes.run_id: Parked (ledger session). Not on the ledger row. P2-A1 telemetry is sidecar analyses[] keys (ADR-033), not this field. Sidecar run_id is the queue copy minted by generate-analysis-queue.py.
field_notes.attempt_count: Required null-ok integer. First-fill is JSON null. Resume-tailor skill increments (null→0)+1 on success or failure. Claim does not increment.
field_notes.started_at: Required null-ok UTC Z. First-fill is JSON null. Resume-tailor skill stamps when that queue job starts. Claim does not write this.
field_notes.completed_at: Required null-ok UTC Z. First-fill and newly minted tailor-queue rows are JSON null. Skill stamps on success. consume_tailor_queue copies the queue value (does not stamp script-now).
field_notes.sandbox_path: Required null-ok. First-fill is JSON null. Copied from the tailor-request row after tailor_complete. Join key to manifest resume_tailor_directory (normalized, trailing slash ignored). On reuse, this copied path wins over newly minted ADR-045 slugs.
field_notes.feature_branch: Required null-ok. First-fill is JSON null. Copied from the tailor-request row. On reuse, checkout this branch when it still exists.
field_notes.pr_number: Required null-ok integer. First-fill is JSON null. Copied after tailor_complete (reuse existing open PR or a new PR if merged/closed).
field_notes.pr_url: Required null-ok URI. First-fill is JSON null. Copied after tailor_complete.
field_notes.artifacts_url: Google Drive {company}/{role} folder URI. CD-only. Empty until deployed.
field_notes.failure: P2-E1 object when status is failed: { code, message, failed_at, step }. code enum: collision|tailor_preflight|tailor_skill|validate|git|pr_create|unknown.

tailor_request_file.notes: Minted by generate-tailor-queue.py from status: approved ledger rows plus last-seen listing and is_current sidecar. Live files are gitignored. Golden samples live under .github/scripts/resume-tailor/tests/fixtures/. Orchestrator copies terminal rows onto approved-jobs.json and deletes the file when drained.

fields.run_id: uuid4 hex, no hyphens. Equals filename stem. Minted by generate-tailor-queue.py.
fields.batch_number: Integer >= 1 in selection order across sliced files.
fields.created_date: UTC calendar date the queue file was minted (YYYY-MM-DD).
fields.jobs: Ordered array of P2-J1 payload rows. Mint status is pending. Each row also carries ledger resume-tailor keys: attempt_count, pr_url, pr_number, sandbox_path, feature_branch (copied as stored, including null) plus started_at and completed_at always null at mint. Terminal status is tailor_complete (plus those keys populated) or failed (plus failure; keep started_at, increment attempt_count).
fields.job_row: Minted keys: id, status, company, title, company_slug, position_slug, location, url, description_text, decision, justification, unmet_mandatory, mentioned_skills, started_at, attempt_count, completed_at, pr_url, pr_number, sandbox_path, feature_branch. id is the listing job_id (ledger PK). company_slug is kebab_case(company). position_slug is kebab_case(title) plus a source_job_id suffix (ADR-045): last 10 characters when longer than 10, otherwise the full source_job_id. Never workday_requisition_id. When ledger sandbox_path/feature_branch are populated, those copied paths win over minted slugs for reuse. Manual resume-tailor (no queue) keeps unsuffixed parent-folder slugs.

analysis_request_file.notes: Minted by generate-analysis-queue.py. Live files are gitignored. Golden samples live under .github/scripts/job-search/tests/fixtures/. Analysis copies envelope run_id onto each filled sidecar row. The queue row is the analysis JD Source of Truth (ADR-050).

fields.run_id: uuid4 hex, no hyphens. Equals filename stem. Same value copied onto filled sidecar analyses[] rows.
fields.batch_number: Integer >= 1 in selection order across sliced files.
fields.created_date: UTC calendar date the queue file was minted (YYYY-MM-DD). Not envelope pull_date.
fields.invoke: Required enum manual|batch. Not mode. Generator --invoke optional, default batch, independent of --job-id. Orchestrator never passes --invoke (P2-G6s --job-id stays batch). Human may pass --invoke manual with --job-id. Skill reads this envelope key only.
fields.jobs: Ordered array of { id, status, company, title, location, work_location_type, url, description_text, skip_reason? }. status is pending at mint, analysis_complete after that job's sidecar persist+validate. Listing fields snapshot normalized job data from the last-seen dated jobs.json at mint. skip_reason is optional free text on skip; clear it when status becomes analysis_complete. No per-job mode.

criteria_file.notes: Multi-id envelope (ADR-041 amends ADR-009). schema $defs.CRITERIA_FILE. job-analysis does not read this file.

fields.criteria: Array of pipeline rows with unique id and pipeline.
fields.jsc_001: pipeline=greenhouse. Title/location/work_location_type/keywords filters only. Loaded by fetch_greenhouse_jobs.py.
fields.jsc_002: pipeline=google_jobs. SerpApi request fields, max_searches billed-request cap, plus empty post-filter title/location includes. Loaded by fetch_serpapi_jobs.py.
fields.jsc_003: pipeline=talentbrew. Capital One company-slot pull. HTTP/query ints, facets (null=omit FacetFilters), titles/locations/work_location_type post-filters. Loaded by fetch_talentbrew_jobs.py. No keywords or match_mode.
fields.jsc_004: pipeline=greenhouse_discovery. Search chips matrix, pagination, probe_verification. Loaded by discover_greenhouse_boards.py. Insert-new companies upsert with ats.enabled=true on probe success (ADR-054).

greenhouse_discovery_jsc_004.search_chips.search_term: Array of title/role query chips. Cartesian product with non-empty filter chips.
greenhouse_discovery_jsc_004.pagination.max_pages_per_query: Max pages to paginate per search chip combination (default 5).
greenhouse_discovery_jsc_004.pagination.request_delay_ms: Sleep between successful Inertia HTTP calls (default 1000).
greenhouse_discovery_jsc_004.pagination.timeout_seconds: urllib timeout for Inertia and probe GETs (default 30).
greenhouse_discovery_jsc_004.pagination.max_retries: Retries on transient 429/503 responses with exponential backoff (default 3).
greenhouse_discovery_jsc_004.probe_verification: Boolean. If true, probes boards-api.greenhouse.io before marking ats.enabled=true on new companies.

talentbrew_jsc_003.search_type/sort_criteria/sort_direction: Same-named TalentBrew list query params. search_keywords/search_location null means unfiltered catalog.
talentbrew_jsc_003.timeout_seconds: urllib timeout for list and detail GETs.
talentbrew_jsc_003.max_retries/retry_status_codes: Retry those statuses; halt if still failing.
talentbrew_jsc_003.max_pages: null paginates until empty/hasJobs false; integer is a hard stop.
talentbrew_jsc_003.titles.include all: Exact token all (case-insensitive) skips the title include gate and is stripped so it never substring-matches. SoT include list does not contain all.
talentbrew_jsc_003.facets: null omits that FacetFilters group. Non-null array is display labels (data-display); unknown label fails closed. Multiple values in one array are OR. facets.locations is the site city facet; post-filter locations remains NJ/NY geography.

talentbrew_facets_map.teams: FacetType 1. Labels include Technology, Engineering, Cyber.
talentbrew_facets_map.remote: FacetType 5 FieldName custom_fields.Remote. Labels Not Remote / Remote / Remote Eligible.

talentbrew_search_results_map.source_job_id: List a[data-job-id] agreeing with href last segment /job/{city}/{slug}/{orgId}/{jobSeqNo}. Not inner span. Not Save Job button. Not Workday R…
talentbrew_search_results_map.workday_requisition_id: Detail span.job-id.job-info / meta job-ats-req-id / JSON-LD identifier
talentbrew_search_results_map.title: List a h2
talentbrew_search_results_map.location: List a .job-location only. Multi-city Primary Address stays in raw.primary_address.
talentbrew_search_results_map.work_location_type: Detail chrome: Primary Address or header containing | Remote; JSON-LD addressCountry Remote; custom_fields.Remote-* (Not-Remote -> onsite). Title (Remote)/Remote Eligible is fallback. Never scan description_text.
talentbrew_search_results_map.posted_at: List .job-date-posted MM/DD/YYYY or JSON-LD unpadded YYYY-M-D
talentbrew_search_results_map.description_text: html_to_text of div.ats-description, else JSON-LD description

jsc_002_wire_map.search_query.include: One billed google_jobs search per string (not OR-joined).
jsc_002_wire_map.location.include: Cartesian with search_query. Empty include (no non-blank entries) is nationwide: no SerpApi location param, regardless of include_remote.
jsc_002_wire_map.industry_query: Appended to every q; does not multiply calls.
jsc_002_wire_map.include_remote: If true, send ltype=1 (Google Jobs remote chip). Does not gate whether a nationwide search runs.
jsc_002_wire_map.max_searches: Required integer >= 1 on jsc_002. Cap on billed SerpApi google_jobs HTTP requests this pull may spend (page 1 and page 2 each count). Not a cap on how many jobs are kept after normalize/dedupe. Preflight QUOTA_STOP if planned fan-out * 2 exceeds this value, plan_searches_left, or daily_cap. daily_cap = min(max_searches, floor(plan_searches_left / utc_days_remaining_including_today)).
jsc_002_wire_map.date_posted: Required. Catalog yesterday|last_3_days|last_week|last_month maps to q_suffix + uds.
jsc_002_wire_map.country_code/language_code/google_domain: Shared on every fan-out call; omit empties.
jsc_002_wire_map.next_page_token: Keep empty on criteria. Runtime follows at most one response token per query.

serpapi_jobs_results_map.title: title
serpapi_jobs_results_map.source_job_id: sha256(opaque job_id) first 8 bytes as decimal

quota.daily: jsc_002.max_searches is the billed-search ceiling for the run. daily_cap = min(max_searches, floor(plan_searches_left / utc_days_remaining_including_today)). There is no max-jobs keep-limit; all unique jobs that survive normalize/filter are written.
quota.QUOTA_STOP: Exit 0 with Mode skip when preflight planned searches exceed budget; Greenhouse commit continues.
quota.account_api: Free account.json is authoritative; do not rely on gitignored quota.json.
